title: Hardship waiver share for continence customers who also hold an Ostomy Supply Program
content:
The waiver share under an approved hardship application on the Urology and Continence Supply Program depends on the customer's Ostomy Supply Program, when they hold one. Larkfield's financial counseling team reads that program's status, its balance due and its hardship applications.

## Share schedule

| Customer's Ostomy Supply Program | Waiver share |
|---|---|
| held in active status, and the customer's latest ostomy hardship application is approved and was received within the last 12 calendar months | replaced by the whole: a share of 1 |
| held in active status and carrying a balance due above zero, with no such approved application | replaced by three quarters: a share of 0.75 |
| any other situation, including holding no active Ostomy Supply Program | stays one half: a share of 0.5 |

The latest ostomy hardship application is the customer's ostomy hardship application with the latest received date. It counts only when its status is approved and it was received fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the waiver date.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- Active Ostomy Supply Program; latest ostomy hardship application approved 5 months ago. The share is the whole.
- Active Ostomy Supply Program with 42.00 USD due; latest ostomy hardship application approved 14 months ago. That application is outside 12 months, so the share is three quarters.
- Active Ostomy Supply Program with a balance of 0.00 USD and no qualifying application: one half.
- Ostomy Supply Program closed, whatever its balance or applications: one half.
- Active Ostomy Supply Program whose latest hardship application was declined, with 15.00 USD due: three quarters.
